676:t_5:16.en:
$$竜馬$$
「They understand words, but not reason... So you could say communication with them is impossible after all.」

676:t_5:17.en:
$$アムロ$$
「They are incompatible beings we can't come to understand...」

676:t_5:18.en:
$$隼人$$
「They evolved in a different direction from us. The $$御使い$$s judged that to be $$バアル$$ and classified them as enemies.」

676:t_5:19.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Still, they were actually beings carrying a factor called the Great Void, so in the end, they were enemies of all life.」

676:t_5:20.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What is the Great Void?」

676:t_5:21.en:
$$隼人$$
「In other words, it is nothingness... It is the very force that seeks to vanish.」

676:t_5:22.en:
$$刹那$$
「It opposes the force that seeks to exist... So it causes the universe's great collapse every 120 million years?」

676:t_5:23.en:
$$甲児$$
「If it produces $$バアル$$, calling the $$インベーダー#robot$$s with that factor $$バアル$$ wouldn't be wrong.」

676:t_5:24.en:
$$シン$$
「So you fought enemies like that...」

676:t_5:25.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's nothing to be surprised about. In the end, we even wiped out the dimensional rift that produced them.」

676:t_5:26.en:
$$シン$$
「How on earth did you do that?!」

676:t_5:27.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「His life drew out the power of the $$ゲッター線$$. That was the result.」

676:t_5:28.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ゼウス$$... So you joined us too.」

676:t_5:29.en:
$$シン$$
「So even a god has come over to our side.」

676:t_5:30.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「I am no longer a god of $$オリュンポス$$. I am one life in this universe and a warrior who protects its lives, just as you do.」

676:t_5:31.en:
$$甲児$$
「Apparently, $$ゼウス$$ has avoided interfering with us more than necessary because of his duty as a higher-dimensional life-form.」

676:t_5:32.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Then why are you helping us now?」

676:t_5:33.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「I thought you would be able to understand why.」

676:t_5:34.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Is it because humanity is standing at the threshold of evolution?」

676:t_5:35.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「That is correct. By touching the truth, you will eventually attain $$シンカ$$ and reach the stage called the radiance of the sun.」

676:t_5:36.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Truth... $$シンカ$$... the radiance of the sun...」

676:t_5:37.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「It is the duty of higher-dimensional life-forms, as elder brothers, to watch over the growth of the younger brothers who follow them.」

676:t_5:38.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「The $$御使い$$s should be fulfilling that role as well.」

676:t_5:41.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「What is certain is that they are the oldest race in existence across all parallel universes.」

676:t_5:42.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$, who has the memories of the $$堕天翅$$, spoke of a tie going back 120 million years.」

676:t_5:43.en:
$$アムロ$$
「They may even have existed since this universe was born...」

676:t_5:44.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We don't even know where they are, but first, there's something we have to do.」

676:t_5:45.en:
$$シン$$
「You mean the decisive battle with the $$宇宙怪獣$$ that nest at the center of the galaxy.」

676:t_5:47.en:
$$號$$
「If they truly are $$バアル$$, defeating them will weaken the force that seeks to vanish and let us prevent the universe's great collapse.」

676:t_5:48.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The next battle... will decide the fate of the universe...」

676:t_5:49.en:
$$刹那$$
「We must win... for the sake of every life in this universe...」

676:t_5:52.en:
$$アルト$$
「I seem to be a little tired.」

676:t_5:53.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You did so much today, $$アルト$$.」

676:t_5:54.en:
$n
「You did. I was amazed you came through that $$時空震動$$ unharmed.」

676:t_5:55.en:
$$宗介$$
「Now, like me, you have earned the right to call yourself a $$時空震動$$ Returnee.」

676:t_5:56.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Nobody wants a name like that...」

676:t_5:57.en:
$$カレン$$
「I wonder if it was the power of the $$ＹＦ－２９$$'s $$フォールドウェーブシステム$$ after all?」

676:t_5:58.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So basically, you mean the power of love?」

676:t_5:60.en:
$n
「You... look like you've put everything behind you...!」

676:t_5:61.en:
$$カレン$$
「This battle settled all sorts of things for him.」

676:t_5:62.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If you're tired, take a rest with $$ランカ$$-chan.」

676:t_5:63.en:
$$アルト$$
「Sorry... I'll take you up on that today.」

676:t_5:64.en:
$$アルト$$
(That feeling... was a little different from the other times I've used the $$フォールドウェーブシステム$$...)

676:t_5:65.en:
$$アルト$$
(It was as if the $$ＹＦ－２９$$'s wings had become part of my body...)

676:t_5:66.en:
$$アルト$$
(What was that feeling...? And what on earth was that power...?)

676:t_5:69.en:
$$アルト$$
「I seem to be a little tired.」

676:t_5:70.en:

「This battle settled all sorts of things for him.」

676:t_5:79.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If you're tired, take a rest with $$シェリル$$.」

676:t_5:80.en:
$$アルト$$
「Sorry... I'll take you up on that today.」

676:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You are thinking about $$ミカゲ$$, aren't you?」

676:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's all right, $$ミコノ$$. He probably entered this battle knowing what he faced from the very beginning.」

676:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And sharing his heart with you must have brought him some satisfaction, since it produced 100 Z in $$Ｚチップ$$s like this.」

676:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even $$ミカゲ$$, who embodied the $$堕天翅$$'s hatred, had a moment when his heart was fulfilled. I'll add these to the team's stock.」

676:t_10:10.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$. I feel a little better now.」

676:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're welcome. But you should talk to $$アマタ$$ about things like this first.」

676:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「After all, he's the one you love most.」

676:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I do enjoy seeing that bashful face.」
